titulo_da: Læsning 3 · Fortæller og perspektiv i prosa
titulo_es: An omitted explanation · Narrator and prose perspective

texto: In prose, it separates who narrates who perceives. A scene can omit explanations and let the reader infer a motive from gestures, references and time changes.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.da: Hun lagde nøglen på bordet og gik uden at se tilbage.
frases.es: Dejó la llave sobre la mesa y se marchó sin mirar atrás.
frases.en: He left the key on the table and left without looking back.

frases.da: Teksten fortæller ikke, hvorfor hun tog af sted.
frases.es: El texto no cuenta por qué se marchó.
frases.en: The text doesn't count why he left.
